verdict.rationale: The evidence covers API order submission, automated guarantee decisions, webhooks, and Decision Center policy checkpoints. Nothing documents team review features such as case assignment, escalation, review SLAs, or an audit trail of who approved what and why. Decision Center policies and the Get Decision API are adjacent automation features, not a human review workflow.

support.subject: As an ops user, review work is a team workflow — assignment, escalation, SLAs, and a decision audit trail that shows who approved what and why
